name: smart-scheme-portal-root
description: Smart Scheme & Scholarship Recommendation Portal Monorepo Root

scripts.start:prod: npm run build && npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
